Bihar BPSC Factory Inspector Revised DV Schedule 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Revised DV Schedule for the post of Factory Inspector. This recruitment has been issued for 12 posts. Online applying process for BPSC Factory Inspector Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 12 January 2026 to 02 February 2026. The Document Verification is Schedule from 07 July to 24 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BPSC Factory Inspector DV Schedule 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 January 2026
  • Last Date : 02 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 February 2026
  • DV Schedule : 07 July to 24 August 2026 (Postponed)
  • New DV Schedule : 11 to 21 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
